caption: The video captures a close, slightly elevated view of a round analog motorcycle speedometer with a chrome bezel and a glass face dotted with water-like droplets, its white pointer resting near the low end of the km/h scale. In the sunlit background, interlocking paving stones, a motorcycle draped in a blue tarp on a stand, and other parked scooters shift slightly as the handheld camera sways. A white hand-held object bearing a partial letter 'P' moves in and out along the right edge of the frame. The speedometer needle stays essentially still, showing no sustained sweep or rise. A blurry bare hand and arm sweep in from the top right, briefly occluding the upper portion of the dial, then withdraw. The hand re-enters the right side intermittently while a soft out-of-focus shape lingers at the top-right corner between passes. Reflections on the glass shift as the hand and object pass in front of the dial. The gauge stays the central subject throughout, its framing wobbling gently with the camera.
